node.title: KoalaBear K3 active component and orientation assembly
node.statement: Conditional on the active balanced-core bad-slope-to-component bridge, the proved order-two component trichotomy, complete positive-coordinate payment, complete negative-coordinate exclusion, complete remaining source-line and biquadratic source-cover payments, and complete trivial-stabilizer payment, every active KoalaBear Z_BC slope is owned exactly once. The order-two image splits into coordinate, source-line, and source-cover branches; the separate (m,r,delta)=(2,8,1) image is paid by U_trivial. The theorem outputs U_geometry=U_source_line+U_source_cover+U_trivial and preserves received line, witness support, affine slope, exact bridge multiplicity, and first-match chronology.
node.falsifier: An active balanced-core slope outside the bridge image, a component outside the order-two or trivial-stabilizer types, an omitted source-line row or source-cover passport, overlap between owners, or loss of received-line/support/slope identity or bridge multiplicity.
